text: Live source audit, material validation obligation: new C++ find_service_any/start_find_service_any currently delegate registered InstanceSpecifier straight to GetServiceDiscovery. Registration string may resolve to a concrete instanceId; that would silently return Specific results under Any. Resolve selector through IRuntime.resolve, require nonempty wildcard identifiers with InstanceIdentifierView.GetServiceInstanceId()==nullopt (and supported LoLa deployment), return nullptr/error for concrete or unmapped selector. Avoid assuming configuration omission merely from macro naming/comments. Add meaningful malformed/concrete-selector rejection regression. No source changes by reviewer; keep original correction budget and finish implementation/tests/report in this same admitted source stage.
